# Tecrese

> The intelligence layer for the agentic internet. Tecrese publishes independent guides, comparisons, and directories for AI agents, coding tools, models, MCP servers, and security research.

Tecrese is a free, no-signup resource. Guides are tested against current APIs and updated when tools change. The site is canonical at https://tecrese.com.

## Start here

- [AI Launchpad](https://tecrese.com/launchpad): Copy-paste install, auth, and first-run commands for six AI tools on macOS, Linux, and Windows.
- [Guides & Tutorials](https://tecrese.com/guides): Step-by-step AI agent, coding tool, and model tutorials.
- [Editorial & News](https://tecrese.com/news): Analysis of model releases, agent frameworks, and security incidents.
- [AI Glossary](https://tecrese.com/dictionary): Plain-English definitions for agentic AI terms.

## Tool setup guides

- [Install Codex CLI](https://tecrese.com/launchpad/codex): OpenAI's terminal coding agent.
- [Install Google Antigravity](https://tecrese.com/launchpad/antigravity): Google's agentic IDE and CLI.
- [Install Claude Code](https://tecrese.com/launchpad/claude-code): Anthropic's terminal coding agent.
- [Install GitHub Copilot CLI](https://tecrese.com/launchpad/copilot-cli): Copilot in the terminal.
- [Install Ollama](https://tecrese.com/launchpad/ollama): Run open models locally.
- [Gemini API quickstart](https://tecrese.com/launchpad/gemini-api): First call with the Google Gen AI SDK.

## Directories

- [AI Agents](https://tecrese.com/agents): Capabilities, pricing, deployment, and security notes.
- [AI Tools](https://tecrese.com/tools): Developer tools and coding agents.
- [AI Models](https://tecrese.com/models): Context windows, pricing, and agent suitability.
- [Agent Frameworks](https://tecrese.com/frameworks): LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, and more.
- [MCP Servers](https://tecrese.com/mcp-servers): Model Context Protocol servers and security considerations.
- [Security Intelligence](https://tecrese.com/security): Active agent security alerts and research.
